items.question: What technology solutions does Aptus Infotech provide?
items.answer: Aptus Infotech provides integrated ELV and software solutions for businesses, covering areas such as security systems, networking, structured cabling, access control, surveillance, AV, automation, cybersecurity, business software and engineering applications.

items.question: Can Aptus recommend the right solution based on our business requirements?
items.answer: Yes. Our team first understands your business, site requirements, existing infrastructure and operational needs before recommending the most suitable technology, products and software.

items.question: Do you provide both products and installation services?
items.answer: Yes. We provide end-to-end support, including solution consultation, product supply, installation, configuration, implementation and ongoing technical support.

items.question: What ELV solutions does Aptus provide?
items.answer: Our ELV solutions include CCTV and video surveillance, access control, gate automation, structured cabling, networking, data centre infrastructure, audio-visual solutions, IP PBX, UPS, GRMS, smart home solutions and other integrated systems.

items.question: What software solutions does Aptus provide?
items.answer: We provide software solutions across design and engineering, business productivity, creative applications, cybersecurity, quantity takeoff, structural engineering, multimedia and educational software, including solutions from leading technology brands.

items.question: Can you integrate different ELV systems with our existing infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. We can assess your existing infrastructure and design solutions that integrate with your current systems, helping improve connectivity, security, efficiency and scalability.

items.question: Do you provide support after installation or software purchase?
items.answer: Yes. Our relationship does not end after the sale. We provide technical assistance, maintenance, troubleshooting, software support and renewal assistance to help keep your systems running effectively.

items.question: Can Aptus help us upgrade our existing technology infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. Whether you need to upgrade your network, security systems, software or other technology infrastructure, we can assess your current environment and recommend practical upgrade options.

items.question: Do you provide annual maintenance and support for ELV systems?
items.answer: Yes. We can provide ongoing maintenance and support to help keep ELV systems reliable, secure and operational while reducing unexpected downtime.

items.question: Can Aptus provide a complete technology solution for a new office or project?
items.answer: Yes. We can support new projects with solutions covering networking, structured cabling, security, access control, AV, communication systems, software and other technology requirements, helping you manage multiple requirements through one technology partner.

items.question: How can Aptus help us select the right software or ELV products?
items.answer: We evaluate your requirements, budget, existing infrastructure and future needs before recommending suitable solutions. Our objective is to help you select technology that delivers long-term value rather than simply supplying products.

items.question: Do you provide software licence renewals and ELV system maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We support both software licence renewals and ongoing ELV maintenance, helping customers manage their technology requirements beyond the initial purchase.

items.question: Can you provide solutions for both small and large projects?
items.answer: Yes. We support technology requirements across different project sizes, from individual software requirements and small office installations to larger enterprise and infrastructure projects.

items.question: Why should I choose Aptus for my technology requirements?
items.answer: Aptus brings software and ELV expertise together under one roof, allowing customers to work with a single technology partner for consultation, products, implementation and ongoing support.

items.question: Can Aptus manage our complete technology requirement?
items.answer: Yes. From software licences and cybersecurity to networking, security, structured cabling, AV and automation, Aptus can help design, implement and support the technology infrastructure your business needs.
